paragraphs.text: In the summer of 2022, researchers in Madrid measured temperatures on 40 streets at 3 pm. Streets lined with mature plane trees were, on average, 4 degrees cooler at pavement level than streets without trees.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Shade explains most of the difference, but not all of it. Trees also release water vapour through their leaves, a process called transpiration, which cools the surrounding air in the same way that sweat cools the skin.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The benefits depend on the size of the tree. Young trees planted in narrow pits often grow slowly and provide little shade for the first ten years, because their roots cannot spread under the road. Such trees also need more water in their first summers.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Madrid now requires new street trees to be planted in continuous trenches filled with a special soil that allows roots to grow beneath the pavement. The city aims to plant 30,000 trees in this way by 2030.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: measured temperatures on 40 streets at 3 pm
items.prompt: At what time of day were the temperatures measured?

explanation.en: “measured temperatures on 40 streets at 3 pm” → 3 pm. 40 is the number of streets and 2022 the year, but the question asks for a time.
explanation.kk: «measured temperatures on 40 streets at 3 pm» → 3 pm. 40 — көше саны, 2022 — жыл, ал сұрақ тәулік уақытын сұрайды.
explanation.ru: «measured temperatures on 40 streets at 3 pm» → 3 pm. 40 — число улиц, 2022 — год, а спрашивают время суток.

items.quote: Streets lined with mature plane trees
items.prompt: What kind of trees lined the cooler streets?

explanation.en: “Streets lined with mature plane trees” → plane trees. “Mature plane trees” is three words, over the limit.
explanation.kk: «Streets lined with mature plane trees» → plane trees. «Mature plane trees» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «Streets lined with mature plane trees» → plane trees. «Mature plane trees» — три слова, это больше лимита.

items.prompt: What is the process called in which trees release water vapour?

explanation.en: “release water vapour through their leaves, a process called transpiration” → transpiration. “Shade” is a different cause of cooling.
explanation.kk: «release water vapour through their leaves, a process called transpiration» → transpiration. «Shade» — салқындаудың басқа себебі.
explanation.ru: «release water vapour through their leaves, a process called transpiration» → transpiration. «Shade» — другая причина охлаждения.

items.quote: provide little shade for the first ten years
items.prompt: For how long may young trees in narrow pits give little shade?

explanation.en: “provide little shade for the first ten years” → ten years. The question is “how long”, so a period is needed, not 2030.
explanation.kk: «provide little shade for the first ten years» → ten years. «How long» сұралған, сондықтан 2030 емес, мерзім керек.
explanation.ru: «provide little shade for the first ten years» → ten years. Спрашивают «how long», поэтому нужен срок, а не 2030.

items.quote: The city aims to plant 30,000 trees in this way by 2030
items.prompt: How many trees does Madrid plan to plant in trenches by 2030?

explanation.en: “aims to plant 30,000 trees in this way by 2030” → 30,000. 2030 is the year, but the question is “How many”.
explanation.kk: «aims to plant 30,000 trees in this way by 2030» → 30,000. 2030 — жыл, ал сұрақ «How many».
explanation.ru: «aims to plant 30,000 trees in this way by 2030» → 30,000. 2030 — год, а вопрос «How many».
